sentiment.rationale: Full-year 2026 revenue guidance was raised by $2B at both ends to $82B-$85B, and EPS guidance was raised by $2.00 at both ends to $35.50-$37.00, representing a 28% growth midpoint. This is a material upward revision to the company's own prior guidance, supported by a 56% revenue beat and highly confident management language. No meaningful risks or Q&A pushback were identified in the provided excerpt to discount the positive forward signal.
